Author: Meowmeowmeow Cat
Name: Skyrim Compass
Punchline: I got Moodles + Loci playing (somewhat) nice. Oh and theres a compass, too.
Description: Adds a Skyrim-style compass bar at the top of your screen. Shows cardinal directions, nearby entity markers, (players, enemies, gathering nodes, etc.) as well as several combat hug replacements. Use /compass to toggle and /compass config to open settings.
